description: Image Description: The image features a doll dressed in a bunny-themed outfit. The outfit includes a hood with bunny ears and a zip-up front. The doll has distinct facial features with large eyes and blonde hair peeking out from under the hood. It is holding a plush orange carrot, which is a prominent accessory. The background is a colorful, patterned fabric with various abstract floral designs in shades of green, purple, and red. The overall scene has a playful and whimsical feel.
